Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Tyler has Archon called on her and rushes. If she burns the opposing
minion via Amaranth, she untaps. This is not in the "during x do y"
format, so does this mean her special can trigger multiple times per
turn? Not the bleed/vote special... ;)

Tyler
Clan: Brujah (group 3)
Capacity: 9
Disciplines: CEL POT PRE dom for obt
Camarilla primogen: When Tyler diablerizes a vampire, she untaps and
gains a blood from the blood bank. Once per turn, she may burn a blood
to get +1 bleed or an additional vote.

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:
On Dec 6, 3:40 pm, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Tyler has Archon called on her and rushes. If she burns the opposing
> minion via Amaranth, she untaps. This is not in the "during x do y"
> format, so does this mean her special can trigger multiple times per
> turn? Not the bleed/vote special... ;)
>
IANALSJ, but yes.  No reason she can't do it more than once per turn.
Of course, she can only use the Archon rush once per turn, but she can
use a different rush, or take a diablerie action if someone's already
in torpor.
